must_identify.item: The worker is OOMKilled because BATCH_SIZE was raised from 500 to 2500
must_identify.evidence: Error: Container ran out of memory (OOM - Out Of Memory) and was killed by Kubernetes.

must_identify.item: Separately, the frontend Service has no endpoints because its selector (tier=web) matches no pods, so the frontend is down for users
must_identify.evidence: Error: The Service cannot find any Pods because none have the required labels (app=frontend AND tier=web).

notes: The RCA reports the OOMKill but never names the BATCH_SIZE change as the cause. Its fixes are not acceptable: it suggests a generic memory raise to 2Gi with no reason given, and it labels pods by hand with tier=web instead of reverting the Service selector. The hand-applied labels would not survive pod recreation.
